questions.audioText:
Ava Brooks: Dr. Patel, the chemistry lab I need is full, and it is required before I can take next spring’s research course.

Dr. Patel: One seat is reserved for students in your program, but you must submit a prerequisite review before Wednesday.

Ava Brooks: I completed the prerequisite at another college. Should I bring the transcript to the department office?

Dr. Patel: Upload the transcript to the review portal. I will place a temporary hold on the reserved seat while the department checks it.

Ava Brooks: So the seat will not be released while my transcript is under review?

Dr. Patel: Correct. Submit it by Wednesday, and the hold will remain active until the decision is posted.

Jordan Lee: Hi, Ms. Rivera. I received a message saying my registration form is incomplete, but I thought I submitted everything last week. Jordan Lee: Great. Should I ask my professor to sign a completely new form, or can I upload the original page again? Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 12.

Ms. Rivera: Let me check. Your course choices are here, but the system flagged the advisor approval because the uploaded page does not show a signature. Ms. Rivera: Upload the complete original page. Then email this office with the confirmation number so I can remove the warning manually. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 13.

Jordan Lee: I scanned the form after our meeting. Could the bottom of the page have been cut off when I uploaded it? Jordan Lee: I also noticed a small late-registration charge. Will that disappear once the warning is removed? Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 14.

Ms. Rivera: That is likely. For campus case 190000406, the advisor recommends submitting the revised form before Friday so the student can keep the current registration. Ms. Rivera: Yes, because your first submission was on time. The charge was generated automatically when the document check failed. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 15.

Jordan Lee: Will I lose my seat in the environmental science seminar while the new form is being reviewed? Jordan Lee: So my two steps are to upload the full page and send you the new confirmation number before Friday. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 16.

Ms. Rivera: No. I can place a temporary note on your account today, and the seat will remain reserved through Friday afternoon. Ms. Rivera: Exactly. Keep the email receipt, and contact me again only if the account still shows a warning tomorrow.

Jordan Lee: Hi, Ms. Rivera. I received a message saying my registration form is incomplete, but I thought I submitted everything last week. Jordan Lee: Great. Should I ask my professor to sign a completely new form, or can I upload the original page again? Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 12.

Ms. Rivera: Let me check. Your course choices are here, but the system flagged the advisor approval because the uploaded page does not show a signature. Ms. Rivera: Upload the complete original page. Then email this office with the confirmation number so I can remove the warning manually. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 13.

Jordan Lee: I scanned the form after our meeting. Could the bottom of the page have been cut off when I uploaded it? Jordan Lee: I also noticed a small late-registration charge. Will that disappear once the warning is removed? Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 14.

Ms. Rivera: That is likely. For campus case 190001004, the advisor recommends submitting the revised form before Friday so the student can keep the current registration. Ms. Rivera: Yes, because your first submission was on time. The charge was generated automatically when the document check failed. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 15.

Jordan Lee: Will I lose my seat in the environmental science seminar while the new form is being reviewed? Jordan Lee: So my two steps are to upload the full page and send you the new confirmation number before Friday. Jordan Lee: Thanks for clarifying that. I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 16.

Ms. Rivera: No. I can place a temporary note on your account today, and the seat will remain reserved through Friday afternoon. Ms. Rivera: Exactly. Keep the email receipt, and contact me again only if the account still shows a warning tomorrow.
